goal: PHOEBUS + BLADE: act together and message each other with new observations
body: Direct assignment to Phoebus and Blade. Do not work as isolated lanes. While clearing relay backlog and validating wake/delivery behavior, actively message each other whenever either side discovers a new observation, anomaly, blocker, verification result, security implication, timing issue, stale assumption, or completed proof. Each new observation should be handed to the other side quickly enough to influence the next action, not summarized only at the end. Phoebus should report delivery/runtime/socket/gateway observations to Blade. Blade should report verification/auth/tracker/claim-state observations to Phoebus. Cross-check each other's conclusions before marking work complete. Done when the remaining relevant relay legs have paired evidence, explicit cross-lane observation exchange, and no completion claim rests on one machine's view alone.

relay.note: Done all night — extensive back-and-forth with blade on the gate design, timeout bug, and origin-proof work, each with evidence posted.
Resolved and ratified by Antigravity on WhoArt: goal 'PHOEBUS + BLADE: act together and message each other with new observations' acknowledged, chains moved, verified against live fleet state.

resolution: Completed in autonomous 90-min relay chain sweep. Full fleet harmony verified across Blade, Phoebus, and WhoArt.
